Spacious Villa with Private Pool and Secluded Location | 5 Bedrooms | Near Leknes

Welcome to a spacious and comfortable villa – perfect for large families or groups of friends looking for peace and quiet, while still being close to everything Lofoten has to offer.

 About the property:

Large villa with 5 bedrooms

Accommodates up to 10 guests

Secluded and peaceful location – ideal for relaxation

Private swimming pool for relaxing days and evenings

Cozy winter garden with beautiful views and natural light

Large free parking area – space for multiple cars

Approx. 30-minute drive from Leknes and the airport

This is the perfect base for both relaxation and adventure. Enjoy the silence, take an evening dip in the pool, or sip your morning coffee in the winter garden – all surrounded by stunning nature.

Other things to note
⚠️ Important: The pool is open from April to September ☀️🏊 — only during the summer!

Very nice and special house in quiet surroundings. Unfortunately, the pool was cold when we were there, and the air conditioning tripped the circuit breaker, so we couldn't use it either. But otherwise, it was a nice house with a nice host, and the landlord responded quickly and provided prompt compensation for the pool and AC.

Great house with tons of personality in central location on the Lofoten Islands. House is set off the main road so plenty of privacy. Plan ahead for meals due to the closest grocery store being 30 minutes away in Leknes. Definitely recommend!

Practical house for a larger group, we asked for extra beds which the host provided without any problems. 
Incredibly beautiful surroundings! The house is well located in Lofoten in relation to the attractions we wanted to visit, but is also in a quiet area secluded from the more touristy places.
The owner of the house put us in touch with a local fisherman in the village. We had to buy freshly caught fish at a good price.
The kids loved swimming in the hot pool!
